messages:
Jordan (Sales): Heads up — ACME wants a short POC. They need a sandbox that ingests ~5k invoices, with PII redaction (SSNs, emails) and an eval to prove redaction quality and latency. Can SEs scope and get this started this week?
Maya (SE): I can scope. Quick Qs: target latency SLO? exact sample size? are they okay with synthetic data for anything sensitive?
Jordan (Sales): They want sub-200ms median for typical prompts, throughput around 30 req/s, and redaction F1 target ~0.95+. They'll send 5k rows but want our redaction pattern guidance first.
Maya (SE): Proposed approach: hosted sandbox on a short-lived dedicated pool (2 weeks). Success criteria: p50 latency <200ms, redaction F1 >= 0.95 on labeled set, and avg token cost < $0.003/token. Sound reasonable?
Nora (Solutions Eng): Sounds good. For redaction we usually recommend client-side pre-redact (regex) + our redact endpoint as a safety net. Eval: 1k labelled examples for automated metrics + a small manual review slice. CI to fail on regressions.
Liam (Security): Security checklist items — data residency requirement, KMS-managed keys (SSE-KMS), retention policy (7/30/90 day options), and IP allowlist for any inbound access. We'll need the completed security questionnaire before we hand over long-lived credentials. No production creds in sandbox.
Jordan (Sales): They also asked if we can host the sample data in S3 with server-side encryption and presigned URLs for the sandbox to pull.
Maya (SE): Yes — typical pattern: S3 bucket with SSE-KMS, generate short-lived presigned URLs, and our sandbox runs in a VPC connector to fetch. Alternatively they can upload via our secure upload endpoint if they prefer push.
Nora (Solutions Eng): Actionable plan: 1) Sales collects sample + label schema + NDA if required. 2) SE builds redaction script + eval harness and target prompts. 3) Security approves KMS & network controls. 4) Ops provisions dedicated pool (2-week window). 5) Agree timeline and success criteria with customer.
Jordan (Sales): Timeline ask from ACME: start Monday next week. Can SE + Security turn around in 3 business days if we get samples today?
Maya (SE): Yes if we get the labeled or raw CSV today. I'll draft the eval harness and the prompt set. Example client-side redaction snippet below we can share with them:
```python
import re

def redact(text):
    text = re.sub(r'\b\d{3}-\d{2}-\d{4}\b', '[SSN]', text)
    text = re.sub(r'[\w\.-]+@[\w\.-]+', '[EMAIL]', text)
    return text
```
Nora (Solutions Eng): Ops requirements: create bucket named "acme-poc-<ts>" with KMS alias "alias/acme-poc-kms", temp IAM role for the SE runner with least privilege, and provision dedicated pool: 2 x g4dn.xlarge (or equivalent).
deploy-bot: Automated note — POC ticket created: #POC-8342, ETA: environment ready 48h after approvals and KMS key created.
Liam (Security): I can fast-track the questionnaire review. Jordan, please share their SOC2 attestation and the IP ranges for allowlist — I'll need contact to validate the jumpbox setup.
Jordan (Sales): Sharing now (uploaded to secure staging). Link: https://redwood-secure.example/s/abc123 — sample CSV uploaded, labels pending (I'll add today). @Maya can you confirm you'll start eval once I drop the label set?
Maya (SE): On it. I'll begin as soon as labels are in and post the eval checklist here. :thumbsup:
